qualification.details: Post Graduate Teacher (Account/Commerce): Post Graduate from recognized university in respective subject with at least 50% marks and Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) from national council for Teacher Education Recognized institution. Or Post Graduate with at least 50% marks from recognized university in respective subject and B.A.Ed /B.SC.Ed from any National Council for Teacher Education recognized institution. Medium of study in SSC should be English. Post Graduate Teacher (Biology): Post Graduate from recognized university in respective subject with at least 50% marks and Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) from national council for Teacher Education Recognized institution. Or Post Graduate with at least 50% marks from recognized university in respective subject and B.A.Ed /B.SC.Ed from any National Council for Teacher Education recognized institution. Medium of study in SSC should be Gujarati.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Sarvajanik Vidyalaya Daman Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://daman.nic.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Sarvajanik Vidyalaya Daman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Post Graduate Teacher posts is 15th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Post Graduate Teacher position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Post Graduate Teacher posts in Sarvajanik Vidyalaya Daman Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Post Graduate Teacher role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate degree in the respective subject with at least 50% marks and a B.Ed. Alternatively, a Post Graduate degree with at least 50% marks and B.A.Ed/B.Sc.Ed from an NCTE recognized institution is also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Post Graduate Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Post Graduate Teacher posts is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Central Government guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Post Graduate Teacher position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 47,600 to Rs. 1,51,100 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Sarvajanik Vidyalaya Daman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Which subjects are the Post Graduate Teacher vacancies for?
faq.answer: The vacancies are for Post Graduate Teacher (Account/Commerce) and Post Graduate Teacher (Biology).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Daman Administration, which is https://daman.nic.in/.
